description: This file declares an interface class 'IGstDispatcherThreadClient' for handling GStreamer bus messages within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It includes a pure virtual method 'handleBusMessage' that must be implemented by derived classes to process GstMessage objects.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThreadClient
classes.description: An interface class for handling GStreamer bus messages, requiring implementation of 'handleBusMessage'.

methods.name: handleBusMessage
methods.description: Callback method to handle a new GstMessage received on the bus.
